answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 33419 Country: India Title: running medical clinic without degree Question: A person who has no registration or degree of medical but he is running his clinic without any fear. He is retired from his duty as well as gets pension. Does he have rights for running the medical clinic? Answer ID: 33419 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1224/1224/M=1432) If running a clinic without a medical degree is a illegal, then it is not right to go against the law and endanger one's life and wealth. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
